chapter: Sidemen, the Hampton years, race and money
title: Six marriages and six children
summary: Music cost him wives; he gives the children's ages.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: It's hard to look back and say what I did. Or say how I was feeling. Music was the most important thing in the world to me. I lost five wives like that. Because I --
You were married five times? Six times.
Just about -- let's see, probably six. I was married six, where they have children.
How many children do you have?
They range in age from Charles, Jr., -- how old is he now?
He's in his '30s. He was born in 1942.
How old does that make him?
And how old is the youngest?
13. That's what Carolyn is, isn't it, Sue?
